item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q009_heme_bundle_fold_not_homology","answer":"No. In SCOPe 2.08 these are three separate superfamilies within the same fold: transmembrane di-heme cytochromes are f.21.1 (SUNID 81342), fumarate-reductase respiratory-complex transmembrane subunits are f.21.2 (SUNID 81343), and respiratory nitrate-reductase 1 gamma chains are f.21.3 (SUNID 103501). All are children of the heme-binding four-helical-bundle fold f.21 (SUNID 81344), whose core is a four-transmembrane-helix up-and-down bundle binding one or two hemes. SCOPe explicitly says that fold-level placement does not imply homology; homology is implied only within each listed superfamily. The f.21.3 annotation notes a possible link to the other superfamilies and structural similarity to FrdC, but that tentative observation does not merge them into one homologous superfamily. Therefore their shared topology and heme-binding architecture must not be used to transfer family membership, specific respiratory function, ligand details, or evolutionary ancestry among the three groups. Fold-level templates may help model coarse topology or heme placement, but not establish cross-superfamily homology or functional equivalence. Representatives should be selected separately from each superfamily rather than treating one fold representative as representative of all three; any proposed unification would require independent cross-group sequence/profile evidence, structure alignments, and phylogenetic support.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__search_scop — /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=Transmembrane+di-heme+cytochromes&mode=auto&limit=10","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81342; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81342/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81342/homology","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81343; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81343/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81343/homology","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/103501; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/103501/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/103501/homology","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81344; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81344/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/81344/homology"]}]}
